key.jaymospowers.web_arm: Symbiote Arm: stow what you hold, or draw the picked thing (Sneak: next slot)
key.jaymospowers.web_arm_use: Symbiote Arm: hold to have the tendril use the picked thing
key.jaymospowers.web_mantle: Symbiote Mantle: unfurl or furl the cape
power.jaymospowers.web.key.ultimate.symb: Feed the symbiote meat from your hand, or consume what you hold
Web Strike, or feed the symbiote meat from your hand, or consume what you hold
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.arm_lo: It won't carry things for you yet. Bond %s.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.mantle: It won't spread itself for you yet. Bond %s.
It spreads from your shoulders, a dark cloak.
It draws the cloak back into you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.arm_un: We can carry things now. Three, in the arm. %s to stow, or to draw.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.mantle: We can spread wide, a cloak. It slows a fall. %s.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.red.se: We feel them. Every heart. Every step. Through the stone.
The dark is ours. We are strong in the dark.
No light here. Good. We are quick.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sun.1: The sun. It burns. We are weak in it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.sun.3: Light on us. We slow. We ache.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.full.2: We cannot hold more. Not now.
We are full, thank you. Truly.
No more for now. You should eat.
We are not hungry. Save it.
That is rotten. We will not.
No. It is dead too long. It is foul.
We do not eat the rotting.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.red.fu: Full. Bring us something that screams later.
Too much. We will burst. Not yet.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.red.ca: Dead long. We do not care.
